title: Intrinsic DVR unit criterion under canonical coefficient transport
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R$ and uniformizer $t$, a datum $d$ with ideal $(t)$, a scheme $T$, and a canonical coefficient model $C$ of [def-sf-open-quotient-koszul-models]. For every unbounded derived completed-integral module $P$, quotient Roos completeness [def-weil-derived-complete] is equivalent to invertibility of the specified singleton intrinsic Koszul completion unit [prop-weil-pbc-koszul-reconstruction] of $C(P)$ for $t$. This is an equivalence of predicates for the actual unit, without a chosen arbitrary completion isomorphism.

proof.text: Choose a flat-term K-flat representative of P and a prime p greater than ell+1. Apply roosIntrinsicCompletenessEquivalence to identify the defining unrestricted quotient Roos predicate with invertibility of the specified IntegralOnSlice.completionUnit. The generator equation follows from hd and the range of the constant map on Fin 1.

Apply openDvrRoosCompletionComparison. Its comparison is an isomorphism and carries the specified completed-adic quotient unit to the scalar image of the specified integral completion unit. Since C.derived is an equivalence, it reflects and preserves isomorphisms. Therefore these two units are invertible simultaneously.

Koszul reconstruction carries the functorial singleton Koszul unit to the quotient unit. reconstructionKoszulIntrinsicComparison carries that same functorial Koszul unit to completedAdicIntrinsicUnit. Cancel the two comparison isomorphisms to obtain exactly the asserted equivalence for the actual intrinsic unit.

proof_origin.place: F7: Tags 099B/0A0E via the existing integral Roos criterion; normalized quotient scalar transport via Tag 0941; actual Koszul unit equations.

lean.statement:
theorem openDvrIntrinsicCriterion
    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))
    (hd : Ideal.span (Set.range (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦
      Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E)) = d.ideal)
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (C : OpenDvrCoefficientModel l E d T)
    (P : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E T)) :
    IsDerivedCompleteUnrestricted.{u, u} l E T P ↔
      IsIso (completedAdicIntrinsicUnit T d 1
        (fun _ ↦ Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E) (C.derived.functor.obj P))
